facts.fact: The national civil registration agency ANEC states that its mandate includes interconnecting the civil registration centres and consular centres, together with the state company Sénégal Numérique S.A. (SENUM); the page states the mandate only, gives no count of centres connected and does not say the centres are commune offices (undated page, dated here to its publication date, itself a proxy for the day it was retrieved).
